$comment: Consumed by scripts/ci/check_gate_coverage.py. A gate listed here must exist, be invoked by `make check`, be reachable from CI, carry a falsifiability injection, and declare its complete eligible file class. U-30: this file was previously read by nothing.

python_matrix.$comment: Z-12. NORM-039 requires the golden vectors to be exercised on Python 3.9 AND the current CI Python. D-12 sets the >=3.9 floor; docs/development/CI_INVENTORY.md P-03/P-07 name 3.12 as the current supported version. check_gate_coverage.py asserts the workflow really declares this matrix and really runs the certification command in every lane - a lane that boots an interpreter and never executes the vectors closes nothing. W1-B: the production tests join the matrix, because a production implementation proven on one interpreter is not proven.
